kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
احتفيت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَيْتُ (iḥtafaytu) /iħ.ta.faj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# اِحْتَفَيْتَ (iḥtafayta) /iħ.ta.faj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# اِحْتَفَيْتِ (iḥtafayti) /iħ.ta.faj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# اُحْتُفِيتُ (uḥtufītu) /uħ.tu.fiː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
